# Allen Code Co.

> Solo build-to-sell software studio run by Chris Allen. Immersive web experiences, intelligent AI systems, custom SaaS builds, MVP sprints, AI integration, technical audits, acquisition-readiness consulting, custom web development and UI/UX design — plus four in-house SaaS products (three live, one coming soon) and a library of website templates.

## Products
- [My Teachers Toolbox](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/my-teachers-toolbox): AI tools for K-5 teachers, built in real classrooms. Live at myteacherstoolbox.com.
- [UnderFire AI](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/underfire-ai): Interview and salary negotiation coaching, on demand. Live at underfireai.com.
- [Founders Helm](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/founders-helm): A solo founder operating system — ten integrated business tools in one workspace. Live at foundershelm.com.
- [Crew Advisors](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/crew-advisors): Your AI advisory board — expert personas with persistent memory of your business. Coming soon.

## Services
- [Immersive Web Experiences](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Interactive 3D websites, digital environments and experiences designed to make the web something people explore. Timeline and deposit set per project, after scoping.
- [Intelligent AI Systems](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Purpose-built AI assistants, agent teams and intelligent operational systems that do more than generate responses. Timeline and deposit set per project, after scoping.
- [Custom SaaS Builds](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Full custom application, built and shipped by one senior developer. Typical timeline 6–12 weeks.
- [MVP Sprints](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Scope-locked 4–6 week build to get a real product in front of real users. Typical timeline 4–6 weeks.
- [AI Integration & OpenRouter Routing](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Model routing, cost controls, and fallbacks. Typical timeline 1–3 weeks.
- [Technical Audits](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Senior-level codebase and architecture review with acquisition-readiness scoring. Typical timeline 3–5 business days.
- [Acquisition-Readiness Consulting](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Get docs, codebase, and metrics ready for buyer diligence. Typical timeline 2–4 weeks.
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Custom-built websites, static HTML/CSS or React/Vite. Typical timeline 1–3 weeks.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): User flow mapping, high-fidelity mockups, and handoff-ready specs. Typical timeline 1–2 weeks.

## Templates
- [Templates](https://www.allencodeco.com/templates): Website templates, asked about through the project brief. Ready to build, each built with Vite and React and with a live demo: Copper Thistle, a restaurant site (https://copper-thistle.vercel.app/), and Evergreen, a memorial and tribute site (https://evergreen-bay-eight.vercel.app/). Concept previews: a family home page, baby and milestones, a wedding, reunions and events, a portfolio, SaaS landing pages, developer portfolios, dashboard starters and agency sites.
